blocks.text: Saada mixture se aik ya do ajza alag karne ke liye filtration, distillation aur solvent extraction jaise saada tareeqe kaafi hain, lekin pecheeda mixtures ke liye zyada taqatwar tareeqe chahiye. Chromatography aik hama jehat aur ahem tajziyati tareeqa hai jo pecheeda mixture ke alag alag ajza ko do phases ki taraf un ki mukhtalif kashish ke mutabiq alag karta hai. Phoolon ke rang, paani mein aaloodgi ya patton ke dawai ajza jaise pecheeda mixtures is tarah alag ho sakte hain. Chromatography maaddon ki pehchan, safai aur paimaish bohat durusti se karti hai, jo ise dawa, forensic science aur mahauliyati science mein mo'assar jadeed tajziyati aala banati hai.

blocks.alt: Hare patte, teer, aur dhakkan (stopper) wali nali jis mein kaghaz ki patti dhakkan se latki hai; patti par alag hui pattiyan (bands), oopar se neeche: carotene, xanthophyll, chlorophyll a, chlorophyll b aur pheophytin.
blocks.caption: Figure 28.1: Patton ke rangon (pigments) ka pecheeda mixture chromatography se achhi tarah alag hota hai (kitab ki Figure 28.1 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Patte ke hare arq (extract) mein kai rang (pigments) mile hote hain. Har pigment stationary aur mobile phase se mukhtalif had tak juda rehta hai, is liye har aik mukhtalif unchai tak jata aur alag patti (band) banata hai.

blocks.title: Stationary aur mobile phases
blocks.text: Chromatography mein mixture stationary phase, jo apni jagah rehta hai (thos ya thos par thama maaye), aur mobile phase, jo us ke paas se guzarta hai (maaye solvent ya gas), ke darmiyan bat'ta hai. Jo ajza mobile phase ko pasand karein woh zyada door ya tez chalte hain.

Adsorption satah ka amal hai jis mein zarre sirf thos ki bairooni satah par jama hote hain; maslan activated charcoal gases aur gandagi apni satah par jazb karta hai, isi liye filters mein use hota hai. Chromatography ki bohat si qismon mein teen ahem paper chromatography (PC), thin-layer chromatography (TLC) aur gas chromatography (GC) hain.

blocks.prompt: Chromatography mein mixture ka har juzw kitna door jata hai, yeh kya tay karta hai?
blocks.explanation: Stationary aur mobile phases ki taraf us ki nisbati kashish: mobile phase ko jitna zyada pasand kare, utna door (ya tez) chalta hai.

items: Chromatography stationary aur mobile phase ki mukhtalif kashish se mixtures alag karti hai.
